StartTitle: Work with PDF locally and safely
StartOpenHint: Open a document or drop PDF files into this window
RestoreAfterCrash: The previous session ended unexpectedly. Restore open documents?
LanguageRestartNote: The interface language will change after restarting the app.
AboutText:
NexusPDF 0.2.0 (alpha)
Local PDF work: viewing, page organization, extraction, printing, password protection and optimization.
Engines: PDFium (rendering), qpdf (structure and encryption).
Your documents never leave your computer.
ProtectIntro: A copy of the document encrypted with AES-256 will be created. The password will be required to open it.
FileOpenElsewhere: This file is open in another NexusPDF tab or window. Close it there or choose a different file name.
HFTemplateHint: Placeholders: {n} — page number, {N} — total pages, {file} — file name, {date} — date.
FontSizeInvalid: Font size must be a number from 4 to 144.
DecorApplied: Decoration added (will be baked on save)
PlaceHint: Click on a page to place the content (Esc — cancel)
SigIntro: The library is stored only on this computer and is encrypted with your Windows account key. A visual signature is an image; it is not a cryptographic digital signature.
SigEmpty: No templates yet — add a signature image (PNG with a transparent background looks best).
PlaceRectHint: Drag a rectangle on a page (Esc — cancel)
FormModeHint: Click a form field and type; save the document to commit the values
FormFlattenedWarning: Saved. Due to structural edits the interactive form was flattened to static content
SignIntro: A copy with an invisible cryptographic signature (PKCS#7, SHA-256) will be created. The signature certifies authenticity and integrity of the file.
SignNoCerts: No certificates with a private key in the Windows personal store. Pick a PFX/P12 file.
SignNoPrivateKey: The certificate has no private key — nothing to sign with.
SignPfxError: Could not open the PFX file:
SignAlreadySigned: The document already contains signatures. Re-signing would rebuild the file and break them — save the edited copy under a different name and sign that.
SignNotModified: The document has not been modified since signing
SignModifiedAfter: The document WAS MODIFIED after signing
SignUntrusted: The certificate chain is not trusted (e.g. self-signed)
PasswordPrompt: The file “{0}” is password-protected. Enter the open password:
PasswordWrong: The password didn't match. Try again.
ErrorSaveFile: Could not save “{0}”. The original file was not modified.
OrganizeHint: Select pages with the mouse (Ctrl/Shift for multiple), drag to reorder
